items.Sentence: Preliminary treatment includes two automatic bar screens.
Effluent from the influent pump station enters one of two primary clarifiers, where solids settle to the bottom of the tank and are removed.
The hydro gritters remove most of the influent grit and inorganic matter.
the sludge continues to gravity thickeners for further concentration.

Secondary treatment includes four trickling filters ... where most of the soluble organic matter is removed through absorption and utilization by the biological organisms growing on the trickling filter media.
Trickling filter effluent ... flows to the secondary clarifiers where suspended solids are removed before discharge.
The solids are then transferred to anaerobic digesters for further treatment.
The methane is disposed of via a gas burner.
The solids are then drawn off into one of 26 sludge drying beds where the solids are dried for several weeks.
A belt filter press was installed in 2002 to allow for increased solids dewatering capabilities...
Water that is removed from the sludge in the solids handling processes is collected and returned to the plant headworks for treatment.

A large portion of the Facility’s effluent is conveyed offsite to the Desert Water Agency (DWA) Wastewater Reclamation Plant (WRP), where it is subjected to filtration and disinfection (i.e., tertiary treatment).

The effluent that is not conveyed offsite for tertiary treatment ... is discharged to six unlined evaporation/percolation ponds.
